title: 축산자조금의 조성 및 운용에 관한 법률 시행규칙

rows.source_ko: Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs ( Livestock Management Division ), 044-201-2336, 2337
rows.text_en: Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs ( Livestock Management Division ), 044-201-2336, 2337

rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Creation and Operation of Livestock Self-Help Funds and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Creation and Operation of Livestock Self-Help Funds and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Types of Livestock Products) In Article 2, Subparagraph 1 of the Act on the Creation and Operation of Livestock Self-Help Funds (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), the term “livestock products prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to meat, horns, milk, honey, and eggs produced from horses, sheep (including goats and other mountain goats), deer, honeybees, ducks, rabbits, turkeys, geese, quails, and pheasants. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Types of Livestock Products) In Article 2, Subparagraph 1 of the Act on the Creation and Operation of Livestock Self-Help Funds (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), the term “livestock products prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to meat, horns, milk, honey, and eggs produced from horses, sheep (including goats and other mountain goats), deer, honeybees, ducks, rabbits, turkeys, geese, quails, and pheasants. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Composition of the Committee for Preparing the Establishment of a Joint Self-Help Fund, etc.) ① In order for two or more livestock organizations to jointly establish a livestock self-help fund for a single livestock product pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 3 of the Act, they must form a Committee for Preparing the Establishment of a Joint Self-Help Fund (hereinafter referred to as the “Joint Preparatory Committee”).
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Composition of the Committee for Preparing the Establishment of a Joint Self-Help Fund, etc.) ① In order for two or more livestock organizations to jointly establish a livestock self-help fund for a single livestock product pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 3 of the Act, they must form a Committee for Preparing the Establishment of a Joint Self-Help Fund (hereinafter referred to as the “Joint Preparatory Committee”).

rows.source_ko: ② The Joint Preparatory Committee shall be composed of no more than 15 members, and the members shall be persons listed in the following subparagraphs appointed by consultation of the heads of each livestock organization, and the chairperson shall be elected from among the members.
rows.text_en: ② The Joint Preparatory Committee shall be composed of no more than 15 members, and the members shall be persons listed in the following subparagraphs appointed by consultation of the heads of each livestock organization, and the chairperson shall be elected from among the members.

rows.source_ko: 1. Up to 8 livestock farmers
rows.text_en: 1. Up to 8 livestock farmers

rows.source_ko: 2. No more than 4 executives of livestock organizations
rows.text_en: 2. No more than 4 executives of livestock organizations

rows.source_ko: 3. One academic, one consumer, and one distribution expert
rows.text_en: 3. One academic, one consumer, and one distribution expert

rows.source_ko: ③ The Joint Preparatory Committee may resolve the following matters with the attendance of a majority of the registered members and the approval of a majority of the members present.
rows.text_en: ③ The Joint Preparatory Committee may resolve the following matters with the attendance of a majority of the registered members and the approval of a majority of the members present.

rows.source_ko: 1. Establishment of a plan to establish a mandatory livestock self-help fund pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Mandatory Self-Help Fund”) or a plan to establish a voluntary livestock self-help fund pursuant to Article 24 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Voluntary Self-Help Fund”)
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of a plan to establish a mandatory livestock self-help fund pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Mandatory Self-Help Fund”) or a plan to establish a voluntary livestock self-help fund pursuant to Article 24 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Voluntary Self-Help Fund”)

rows.source_ko: 2. Other matters necessary for the establishment of mandatory or voluntary self-help funds
rows.text_en: 2. Other matters necessary for the establishment of mandatory or voluntary self-help funds

rows.source_ko: ④ The Joint Preparatory Committee shall continue to exist until the Mandatory Self-Help Fund Management Committee pursuant to Article 14 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Management Committee”) or the Voluntary Self-Help Fund Committee pursuant to Article 26 of the Act is established.
rows.text_en: ④ The Joint Preparatory Committee shall continue to exist until the Mandatory Self-Help Fund Management Committee pursuant to Article 14 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Management Committee”) or the Voluntary Self-Help Fund Committee pursuant to Article 26 of the Act is established.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 4, matters necessary for the composition and operation of the Joint Preparatory Committee shall be determined by the Chairperson following a resolution by the Joint Preparatory Committee.
rows.text_en: ⑤ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 4, matters necessary for the composition and operation of the Joint Preparatory Committee shall be determined by the Chairperson following a resolution by the Joint Preparatory Committee.

rows.source_ko: Article 4 (Contents of Mandatory Self-Help Fund Establishment Plan) The mandatory self-help fund establishment plan pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall include the following matters:
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Contents of Mandatory Self-Help Fund Establishment Plan) The mandatory self-help fund establishment plan pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall include the following matters:

rows.source_ko: 1. Name of Mandatory Self-Help Fund
rows.text_en: 1. Name of Mandatory Self-Help Fund

rows.source_ko: 2. Reasons and Purposes for Establishing Mandatory Self-Help Funds
rows.text_en: 2. Reasons and Purposes for Establishing Mandatory Self-Help Funds

rows.source_ko: 3. Funding Securing Measures and Operation Plan for Mandatory Self-Help Funds
rows.text_en: 3. Funding Securing Measures and Operation Plan for Mandatory Self-Help Funds

rows.source_ko: 4. Method and procedure for operation in cases where two or more livestock organizations intend to jointly establish and operate a single mandatory self-help fund
rows.text_en: 4. Method and procedure for operation in cases where two or more livestock organizations intend to jointly establish and operate a single mandatory self-help fund

rows.source_ko: Article 5 (Procedures and Methods of Voting, etc.) ① In cases where a livestock organization intends to hold a vote at a representative council regarding the establishment of a mandatory self-help fund pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Act, the head of the livestock organization shall convene a representative council for the vote.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Procedures and Methods of Voting, etc.) ① In cases where a livestock organization intends to hold a vote at a representative council regarding the establishment of a mandatory self-help fund pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Act, the head of the livestock organization shall convene a representative council for the vote.

rows.source_ko: ② When the head of a livestock organization convenes a meeting of delegates pursuant to Paragraph 1, he/she shall send a notice of convocation to the delegates at least 10 days prior to the meeting, stating the purpose and agenda of the meeting and the date and time and place of the meeting.
rows.text_en: ② When the head of a livestock organization convenes a meeting of delegates pursuant to Paragraph 1, he/she shall send a notice of convocation to the delegates at least 10 days prior to the meeting, stating the purpose and agenda of the meeting and the date and time and place of the meeting.

rows.source_ko: ③ Voting shall be one vote per person, and shall be conducted by secret ballot.
rows.text_en: ③ Voting shall be one vote per person, and shall be conducted by secret ballot.

rows.source_ko: Article 6 (Publication of Voting Results) Livestock organizations shall publish the results of the vote conducted pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Act through any of the following media so that livestock producers can easily know them.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Publication of Voting Results) Livestock organizations shall publish the results of the vote conducted pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Act through any of the following media so that livestock producers can easily know them.

rows.source_ko: 1. Daily newspaper
rows.text_en: 1. Daily newspaper

rows.source_ko: 2. Newspapers related to agriculture and livestock
rows.text_en: 2. Newspapers related to agriculture and livestock

rows.source_ko: 3. Bulletin boards or internet homepages of livestock organizations
rows.text_en: 3. Bulletin boards or internet homepages of livestock organizations

rows.source_ko: 제7조(가축사육 마릿수 등의 보고) 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장(자치구의 구청장을 말한다)은 법 제8조제6항에 따라 보고를 할 경우에는 다음 각 호에 해당하는 자를 그 대상으로 하고, 보고의 내용에는 축산업자별로 가축의 종류, 농장명, 대표자의 성명ㆍ주소ㆍ연락처 및 가축사육 마릿수를 포함하여야 한다. <개정 2012. 6. 29., 2015. 12. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Reporting of Number of Livestock, etc.) When a Special Self-Governing City Mayor, Special Self-Governing Province Governor, Mayor, County Head, or District Head (referring to the District Head of an autonomous district) makes a report pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 6 of the Act, the subjects shall be those falling under each of the following subparagraphs, and the contents of the report shall include, for each livestock business operator, the type of livestock, the name of the farm, the name, address, and contact information of the representative, and the number of livestock raised. <Amended Jun. 29, 2012; Dec. 23, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「농업ㆍ농촌 및 식품산업 기본법」 제3조제2호에 따른 농업인
rows.text_en: 1. Farmers pursuant to Article 3, Subparagraph 2 of the Framework Act on Agriculture, Rural Areas and Food Industry

rows.source_ko: 2. 판매를 목적으로 해당 가축을 사육하는 자
rows.text_en: 2. Persons raising the relevant livestock for the purpose of sale

rows.source_ko: 제8조(대의원 후보자의 자격ㆍ등록 및 선거 등) ① 법 제8조제7항에 따른 대의원 후보자(이하 “후보자”라 한다)의 자격은 선거공고일 현재 선출구에 주소나 거소(居所) 또는 사업장을 둔 축산업자로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Qualifications, Registration, and Election of Delegate Candidates, etc.) ① The qualifications of a delegate candidate pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 7 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “candidate”) shall be livestock farmers who have an address, residence, or business place in the electoral district as of the date of the election announcement.

rows.source_ko: ② 후보자로 등록하려는 사람은 투표일 15일 전까지 축산단체가 지정한 장소에서 등록신청을 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Any person who intends to register as a candidate must apply for registration at a place designated by the livestock organization by 15 days prior to the voting day.

rows.source_ko: ③ 축산단체는 투표일 30일 전까지 선거권자를 확정하고, 투표 일시 및 장소, 선거인명부 및 선출구별 대의원 수 등을 공고하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Livestock organizations must determine the eligible voters by 30 days prior to the voting day and announce the date and time and place of voting, the list of voters, and the number of delegates for each electoral district.

rows.source_ko: ④ 축산단체는 투표일 10일 전까지 후보자 명부를 공고하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ Livestock organizations must announce the list of candidates by 10 days prior to the voting day.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 투표는 단기명(單記名) 또는 연기명(連記名)에 의한 비밀투표로 하며, 투표자 1인 1표로 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ Voting shall be conducted by secret ballot using single or multiple names, and each voter shall have one vote.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 투표는 직접 하거나 우편 또는 전자적 방식으로 하되, 우편 또는 전자적 방식의 투표는 투표일 오후 8시까지 축산단체가 지정한 수신처에 도착(전자적 방식에 의한 투표는 정보처리시스템에 입력된 것을 말한다)한 것만 유효한 것으로 본다. <개정 2024. 1. 25.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ Voting shall be conducted in person, by mail, or by electronic means; however, votes by mail or electronic means shall be deemed valid only if they arrive at the recipient designated by the livestock organization by 8:00 PM on the voting day (in the case of electronic votes, this refers to those entered into the information processing system). <Amended Jan. 25, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 축산단체는 직접 투표 방식으로 대의원을 선출하는 경우에는 투표 장소에 투표자 명부를 갖추어 두어야 한다. <개정 2024. 1. 25.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ When a livestock organization elects delegates by direct voting, it shall keep a voter register at the polling place. <Amended Jan. 25, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 축산단체는 법 제8조제5항에 따라 당선자가 결정되었을 때에는 즉시 당선자의 지역 및 성명을 공고하여야 한다. 이 경우 공고의 방법에 관하여는 제6조를 준용한다. <개정 2017. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ⑧ When a winner is determined pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 5 of the Act , a livestock organization shall immediately publicize the winner's region and name. In this case , Article 6 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the method of public announcement. <Amended Jan. 2, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 제1항부터 제8항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 선거 등에 필요한 사항은 해당 축산단체의 규정으로 정한다.
rows.text_en: ⑨ In addition to the matters stipulated in paragraphs 1 through 8, matters necessary for elections, etc. shall be determined by the regulations of the relevant livestock organization.

rows.source_ko: 제9조(관리위원회에 참여하는 위원) 법 제15조제1항제2호에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 관계 공무원”이란 축산물의 생산 및 유통을 담당하는 농림축산식품부 소속 공무원 중에서 농림축산식품부장관이 지명하는 사람을 말한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Members Participating in the Management Committee) In Article 15, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Act , “relevant public officials prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to persons designated by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs from among public officials belonging to the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs who are responsible for the production and distribution of livestock products. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제10조(수납기관에 대한 수수료 지급) 법 제19조제1항 후단에 따른 수수료는 의무거출금의 100분의 7 이내의 범위에서 관리위원회가 수납기관과 협의하여 정한다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Payment of Fees to Receiving Agencies) The fees pursuant to the latter part of Article 19, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be determined by the Management Committee in consultation with the receiving agencies within a range of 7% of the mandatory contributions.

rows.source_ko: 제11조(과오납금의 환급 절차) ① 법 제20조에 따른 과오납금의 환급은 축산업자가 환급을 청구한 날 또는 관리위원회가 과오납금을 확인한 날부터 1개월 이내에 하여야 하며, 관리위원회는 반기(半期)별로 과오납 여부를 확인하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Procedure for Refund of Overpayments) ① The refund of overpayments pursuant to Article 20 of the Act shall be made within one month from the date the livestock business operator requests the refund or the date the Management Committee confirms the overpayment, and the Management Committee shall verify whether there has been an overpayment on a semi-annual basis.

rows.source_ko: ② 관리위원회는 제1항에 따라 과오납금을 환급하였을 때에는 환급 내용을 수납기관에 통보하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② When the Management Committee refunds overpayments in accordance with Paragraph 1, it shall notify the receiving agency of the details of the refund.

rows.source_ko: 제12조(의무자조금의 조달 및 운용에 관한 공시) 관리위원회는 법 제21조제6항에 따라 회계연도마다 의무자조금의 조달 및 운용에 관한 결산보고서를 다음 회계연도 3월 31일까지, 다음 회계연도의 사업계획서를 해당 회계연도 11월 30일까지 각각 대의원회의 승인을 받아 공시하여야 한다. 이 경우 공시의 방법에 관하여는 제6조를 준용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Disclosure of the Procurement and Operation of Mandatory Self-Help Funds) Pursuant to Article 21, Paragraph 6 of the Act, the Management Committee shall disclose the settlement report on the procurement and operation of mandatory self-help funds for each fiscal year by March 31 of the following fiscal year and the business plan for the following fiscal year by November 30 of the relevant fiscal year, respectively, upon obtaining approval from the Council of Representatives. In this case, Article 6 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the method of disclosure.

rows.source_ko: 제13조(의무자조금의 운용에 드는 비용) 법 제21조제7항에 따라 의무자조금의 운용에 드는 비용은 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 기준을 초과할 수 없다.
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Costs incurred in operating mandatory self-help funds) Pursuant to Article 21, Paragraph 7 of the Act , costs incurred in operating mandatory self-help funds shall not exceed the standards according to the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 의무자조금 조성액이 10억원 이상인 경우: 의무자조금 조성액의 100분의 8
rows.text_en: 1. If the amount of the mandatory self-help fund is 1 billion KRW or more: 8% of the amount of the mandatory self-help fund

rows.source_ko: 2. 의무자조금 조성액이 10억원 미만인 경우: 의무자조금 조성액의 100분의 10
rows.text_en: 2. If the amount of the mandatory self-help fund is less than 1 billion won: 10% of the amount of the mandatory self-help fund

rows.source_ko: 제14조(의무자조금 폐지 요청 등에 대한 공표) 법 제23조제5항 및 제6항에 따른 공표의 방법에 관하여는 제6조를 준용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Publication of Requests for the Abolition of Mandatory Self-Help Funds, etc.) The provisions of Article 6 shall apply to the method of publication pursuant to Article 23, Paragraphs 5 and 6 of the Act.

rows.source_ko: 제15조(임의자조금 설치계획서의 내용) 법 제24조에 따른 임의자조금 설치계획서에 포함되어야 하는 사항에 관하여는 제4조를 준용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Contents of Plan for Establishment of Voluntary Self-Help Fund) The provisions of Article 4 shall apply mutatis mutandis to matters to be included in the plan for establishment of a voluntary self-help fund pursuant to Article 24 of the Act.

rows.source_ko: Article 16 (Review of Regulations) The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall review the validity of the qualifications, registration, and election, etc. of delegate candidates pursuant to Article 8 every three years, starting from January 1, 2017 (meaning no later than January 1 of the year marking every third year), and take measures such as improvements. <Amended Jan. 2, 2017>
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Review of Regulations) The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall review the validity of the qualifications, registration, and election, etc. of delegate candidates pursuant to Article 8 every three years, starting from January 1, 2017 (meaning no later than January 1 of the year marking every third year), and take measures such as improvements. <Amended Jan. 2, 2017>

rows.text_en: In Article 2, “Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries” shall be changed to “Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Livestock.”
